roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Pick what each role means in this home. Leave a role empty if the home doesn't have it: layouts skip what is missing.

data.grid_export_positive: Grid meter reports export as positive (e.g. Huawei)

data_description.weather: A weather entity with forecasts (for example weather.home, SMHI or Met.no). Gives the current condition, today's high and low, and the hourly and daily forecasts.
data_description.outdoor_temp: Outdoor temperature sensor (°C), for example your own weather station. Shown as the big number; without it the weather entity's temperature is used.
data_description.indoor_temp: Any other temperature sensor (°C), shown as one row next to the outdoor temperature, for example a conservatory or a porch.
data_description.rain_today: Rain so far today (mm): a daily total that resets at midnight, usually from a weather station.
data_description.price: Electricity price now, per kWh, whose attributes hold the hourly prices: Nord Pool (core or HACS) or ENTSO-e. The price chart needs today's prices, and tomorrow's once they are published (around 13:00 for Nord Pool).
data_description.solar_forecast_today: Expected solar energy today (kWh) from a forecast integration that feeds the Energy dashboard (e.g. Forecast.Solar or Open-Meteo Solar Forecast); Solcast is read from its attributes. The hourly curve is read from the same integration.
data_description.solar_power: Solar production right now (W or kW), the PV power from your inverter.
data_description.grid_power: Power to or from the grid right now (W or kW). Expected: import (buying) is positive. If your meter shows export as positive, tick the box at the bottom.
data_description.house_power: The whole house's consumption right now (W or kW).
data_description.house_energy_today: The house's consumption so far today (kWh): a daily total that resets at midnight.
data_description.battery_power: Home battery power right now (W or kW), charging or discharging. Either sign convention works: the size is shown.
data_description.sun: The sun entity (normally sun.sun): sunrise, sunset and the night shading on the time axis.
data_description.rooms: Indoor temperature sensors (°C), one per room, shown as a list or a status line.
data_description.calendars: Calendar entities whose events are shown in the agenda and the week view.
data_description.feels_like: Feels-like (apparent) temperature sensor (°C), usually from a weather station.
data_description.grid_export_positive: Tick if the grid sensor above shows export (selling) as a positive number, as Huawei meters do. Leave unticked if import is positive.

data_description.layout: Pick a bundled layout or one of your own files from /config/paperboard/, or type a name. A schedule file switches layouts by time of day.

repair_wanted.title: Paperboard: the panel of {screen} wants to pair again
repair_wanted.description:
A panel with the MAC of the {screen} panel (its screen shows the code {code}) asked to pair from {ip} while pairing was closed. This panel last checked in from {last_ip}. That usually means it was reset.

If it is your panel, press **Pair device** on {screen}; afterwards a notification confirms the pairing.

If you did not reset it, or the two addresses differ for no reason, do not press Pair: another device on your network may be using the panel's MAC address.

unknown_device.title: Paperboard: a device keeps polling without a valid key
unknown_device.description:
A device with a MAC ending {mac} polled more than 10 times in an hour from {ip} without a valid key.

If it is your panel, press **Pair device** on its screen and pair it again. If not, a device on your network is trying to act as a panel. This message goes away at the next pairing.

layout_invalid.title: Paperboard layout {file} has errors
layout_invalid.description:
The layout file {file} could not be loaded. Screens keep using the last working version of it (if there was one).

{errors}

role_missing.title: Paperboard: {entity} is gone
role_missing.description: The role {role} is bound to {entity}, which no longer exists. Screens keep working and show a dash or skip that part. Bind the role to another entity under Paperboard → Configure → Roles, or clear it.
